items.stem: A circle has a radius of 7. What is the circumference of the circle?
items.explanation: C = 2πr = 14π (B). 49π — площадь; 7π — забыли множитель 2; 28π — взяли диаметр вместо радиуса.

items.stem: A circle has a diameter of 18 centimeters. What is the radius of the circle, in centimeters?
items.explanation: Радиус — половина диаметра: 18/2 = 9 см.

items.stem: What is the center of the circle with equation (x − 3)² + (y + 2)² = 25 in the xy-plane?
items.explanation: В уравнении (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r² центр (h, k). y + 2 = y − (−2), центр (3, −2) (A). Остальные варианты путают знаки.

items.stem: What is the radius of the circle with equation (x − 3)² + (y + 2)² = 25?
items.explanation: Справа r² = 25, r = 5 (A). 25 — это r²; 12.5 — половина; 625 — возвели в квадрат.

items.stem: In a circle with radius 4, a central angle measures 90°. The length of the arc intercepted by the angle is kπ. What is the value of k?
items.explanation: Дуга — четверть окружности: (90/360) · 8π = 2π, k = 2.

items.stem: How many radians are equal to 180°?
items.explanation: Полный оборот 360° = 2π, значит 180° = π (B). π/2 = 90°; 2π = 360°.

items.stem: An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc that measures 80°. What is the measure of the inscribed angle?
items.explanation: Вписанный угол равен половине дуги: 40° (B). 80° — центральный угол; 160° — удвоили.

items.stem: A sector of a circle with radius 6 has a central angle of 60°. The area of the sector is kπ. What is the value of k?
items.explanation: Сектор — 1/6 круга площадью 36π: 6π, k = 6.

items.stem: A circle has an area of 81π. What is the circumference of the circle?
items.explanation: r² = 81, r = 9, C = 18π (B). 9π — забыли множитель 2; 81π — это площадь.

items.stem: Which equation represents a circle in the xy-plane with its center at the origin and a radius of 4?
items.explanation: x² + y² = r² = 16 (A). x² + y² = 4 — радиус 2; x + y = 16 — прямая; x² − y² = 16 — гипербола.

items.stem: A wheel with a diameter of 50 centimeters makes one complete turn without slipping. To the nearest centimeter, how far does the wheel roll?
items.explanation: За один оборот колесо проходит длину окружности: π · 50 ≈ 157 см.

items.stem: A sector of a circle has a central angle of 120°. What fraction of the area of the circle is the area of the sector?
items.explanation: Доля сектора = угол/360° = 120/360 = 1/3 (C).

items.stem: What is the measure, in degrees, of an angle of π/4 radians?
A line is tangent to a circle at point P. What is the measure, in degrees, of the angle between the tangent line and the radius drawn to P?
items.explanation: Касательная перпендикулярна радиусу, проведённому в точку касания: 90°.

items.stem: In a circle, a central angle and an inscribed angle intercept the same arc. The central angle measures 100°. What is the measure of the inscribed angle?
items.explanation: Вписанный угол вдвое меньше центрального, опирающегося на ту же дугу: 50° (B).

items.stem: The equation x² + y² − 6x + 4y − 12 = 0 represents a circle in the xy-plane. What is the radius of the circle?
items.explanation: Выделяем квадраты: (x − 3)² − 9 + (y + 2)² − 4 = 12, (x − 3)² + (y + 2)² = 25, r = 5 (A). √12 — забыли добавить 9 и 4; 25 — это r².

items.stem: In a circle with a radius of 12, an arc has a length of 4π. What is the measure, in degrees, of the central angle that intercepts the arc?
items.explanation: Длина окружности 24π, дуга — 4π/24π = 1/6 её. 360°/6 = 60°.

items.stem: A sector of a circle with a radius of 10 has an area of 25π. What is the central angle of the sector?
items.explanation: Круг 100π, сектор — его четверть: 90° (B). 45° — восьмая часть; 180° — половина.

items.stem: What is the radian measure of an angle of 225°?
The point (5, 12) lies on a circle centered at the origin. What is the radius of the circle?
items.explanation: Радиус — расстояние до начала координат: √(25 + 144) = 13.

items.stem: A circle in the xy-plane has its center at (2, −1) and passes through the point (5, 3). Which of the following is an equation of the circle?
items.explanation: r² = (5 − 2)² + (3 + 1)² = 25, центр (2, −1) (A). B — знаки центра перепутаны; C — справа r вместо r²; D — центр в точке на окружности.

items.stem: In a circle, chord AB has a length of 16 and is 6 units from the center of the circle. What is the radius of the circle?
items.explanation: Перпендикуляр из центра делит хорду пополам: катеты 8 и 6, радиус √(64 + 36) = 10 (B). 8 — половина хорды; 22 — 16 + 6.

items.stem: A circle has a radius of 6. What is the length of an arc intercepted by a central angle of 2 radians?
items.explanation: В радианах длина дуги s = rθ = 6 · 2 = 12.

items.stem: A circular pizza with a diameter of 16 inches is cut into 8 equal slices. What is the area of one slice, in square inches?
items.explanation: Радиус 8, площадь 64π, один кусок 64π/8 = 8π (B). 32π — подставили диаметр вместо радиуса (16²π/8); 2π — длина дуги одного куска.

items.stem: The minute hand of a clock is 9 centimeters long. How far, in centimeters, does the tip of the minute hand travel in 20 minutes?
items.explanation: За 20 минут стрелка проходит треть круга: 18π/3 = 6π (B). 18π — полный круг; 9π — половина; 3π — шестая часть.

items.stem: An inscribed angle in a circle measures 35°. What is the measure, in degrees, of the arc it intercepts?
items.explanation: Дуга вдвое больше вписанного угла: 70°.

items.stem: Which of the following points lies on the circle (x + 1)² + (y − 4)² = 10?
Two circles have radii of 3 and 6. What is the ratio of the area of the smaller circle to the area of the larger circle?
items.explanation: Площади относятся как квадраты радиусов: 9π : 36π = 1 : 4 (B). 1:2 — отношение радиусов и длин окружностей.

items.stem: A circular garden has an area of 154 square meters. Using 22/7 as an approximation for π, what is the radius of the garden, in meters?
A sector of a circle has a radius of 8 and an arc length of 6π. What is the area of the sector?
items.explanation: Площадь сектора = (1/2) · r · дуга = (1/2) · 8 · 6π = 24π (B). Проверка через угол: 6π/16π = 3/8 круга 64π — тоже 24π. 48π — забыли 1/2; 64π — весь круг.

items.stem: The equation x² + y² + 8x − 10y = −32 represents a circle in the xy-plane. What are the center and the radius of the circle?
items.explanation: (x + 4)² − 16 + (y − 5)² − 25 = −32, (x + 4)² + (y − 5)² = 9: центр (−4, 5), радиус 3 (A). B — знаки центра; C — радиус взят как r²; D — коэффициенты без деления на 2.

items.stem: In a circle with a radius of 10, a chord has a length of 12. What is the distance from the center of the circle to the chord?
items.explanation: Половина хорды 6, радиус 10: расстояние √(100 − 36) = 8.

items.stem: For a circle with radius r, the numerical value of its area is equal to the numerical value of its circumference. What is the value of r?
items.explanation: πr² = 2πr, r = 2 (B; r = 0 не круг). При r = 1 площадь π, длина 2π; π и 4 не уравнивают величины.

items.stem: In a circle with a radius of 15, arc AB is intercepted by a central angle of 3π/5 radians. What is the length of arc AB?
items.explanation: s = rθ = 15 · 3π/5 = 9π (B). 3π — умножили на 5 вместо 15; 45π — забыли деление на 5.

items.stem: The point (k, 4) lies on the circle (x − 2)² + (y − 1)² = 25 in the xy-plane, and k > 2. What is the value of k?
items.explanation: (k − 2)² + 9 = 25, (k − 2)² = 16, k = 6 или k = −2; условие k > 2 оставляет 6.

items.stem: A square is inscribed in a circle with a radius of 5, so all four vertices of the square lie on the circle. What is the area of the square?
items.explanation: Диагональ квадрата — диаметр 10, площадь d²/2 = 50 (B). 100 — квадрат со стороной 10 (описанный около круга); 25 — сторона 5; 25π — площадь круга.

items.stem: Points A and B lie on a circle with center O and radius 6. Central angle AOB measures 2π/3 radians. What is the length of chord AB?
items.explanation: Угол 120°. Высота из O делит треугольник AOB на два 30-60-90 с гипотенузой 6: половина хорды 3√3, хорда 6√3 (B). 4π — длина дуги, а не хорды; 12 — диаметр.

items.stem: A circle has a circumference of 20π. A sector of the circle has a central angle of 72°. The area of the sector is kπ. What is the value of k?
items.explanation: r = 10, площадь круга 100π, сектор 72/360 = 1/5 его: 20π, k = 20.

items.stem: A circle in the xy-plane has its center at (3, 4) and is tangent to the x-axis. Which of the following is an equation of the circle?
items.explanation: Касание оси x: радиус равен расстоянию от центра до оси, |4| = 4, r² = 16 (A). B — касание оси y (радиус 3); D — окружность через начало координат; C — неверные знаки центра.

items.stem: A belt runs around a wheel with a radius of 0.3 meter. The wheel turns at 120 revolutions per minute, and the belt does not slip. To the nearest meter, how many meters of belt pass over the wheel each minute?
items.explanation: Один оборот — 2π · 0.3 = 0.6π м; 120 оборотов — 72π ≈ 226 м (C). 113 — взяли πr вместо 2πr; 72 — коэффициент без π; 452 — удвоили.

items.stem: In a circle, inscribed angle ACB intercepts arc AB, which measures 130°. Inscribed angle ADB, with D on the same side of AB as C, intercepts the same arc. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle ADB?
items.explanation: Все вписанные углы, опирающиеся на одну дугу, равны половине дуги: 65°.

items.stem: The line y = x + 1 intersects the circle x² + y² = 13 in the xy-plane. Which of the following is a point of intersection?
items.explanation: x² + (x + 1)² = 13, 2x² + 2x − 12 = 0, x = 2 или x = −3: точки (2, 3) и (−3, −2) (A). Остальные лежат на прямой, но не на окружности (25, 5 и 5 вместо 13).

items.stem: A right triangle has legs of lengths 6 and 8. A semicircle is drawn outward on each leg, with the leg as its diameter. What is the total area of the two semicircles?
items.explanation: Радиусы 3 и 4: 4.5π + 8π = 12.5π (A). Это как раз площадь полукруга на гипотенузе (r = 5). 25π — целые круги; 50π и 100π — диаметр вместо радиуса.

items.stem: A sector of a circle with a radius of 12 has a perimeter of 24 + 4π (the two radii plus the arc). What is the measure, in degrees, of the central angle of the sector?
items.explanation: Дуга 4π, окружность 24π, доля 1/6: 360°/6 = 60°.

items.stem: The radius of a circle is increased by 50%. By what percent does the area of the circle increase?
items.explanation: Площадь растёт в 1.5² = 2.25 раза, то есть на 125% (C). 225% — это новая площадь в процентах от старой, а не прирост; 50% — рост радиуса.
